result.rationale: Primary sources support Wren House remaining the current legal owner through the review date. T-Mobile announced a 50/50 joint venture transaction for i3 Broadband, but the direct official announcement targeted a second-half 2026 closing and no legal closing was established by the research cutoff; no active-owner change is authorized.

evidence.purpose: Working official announcement for T-Mobile's signed pending 50/50 i3 joint venture and targeted closing.
Working current manager page listing i3 as a Wren House portfolio highlight.
Official FCC notice supporting the i3 ownership chain and platform boundary.
